title: Well and Choir
author: Yara Zhou
blurb: Cyrus Sterling, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
